title: FrontRES 统计量审计图
subtitle: mean/std 与 normalizer 的审计地图. 每个节点说明语义对象, 来源, 消费端, 风险和证据等级; 这是代码审计面, 不是物理效果声明.

nodes.title: 语义统计量总表
nodes.problem: 精确文本搜索找不全 stat 使用点, 因为同一语义会写成 obs_normalizer, gmt_normalizer, obs_norm_state_dict, _mean/_std, normalizer, expert_normalize_obs, exporter.normalizer 等.
nodes.method: 按语义对象审计: GMT suffix stats, FrontRES prefix stats, combined actor obs stats, privileged stats, teacher/expert stats, PPO advantage stats, export/play normalizer stats.
nodes.code: 代码确认的审计起点: CodeGraph impact for apply_obs_normalizer, extract_frontres_extra_norm_stats, compose_frontres_obs_norm_state; targeted search for state_dict/load_state_dict/EmpiricalNormalization/normalizer.
nodes.review: 在 dynamic coverage 或 trace 确认具体 command/run mode 前, 不能把这张图报告为 exhaustive.
nodes.forbidden: 不能只凭一个本地 contract test 或 exact-name grep 就断言 stat 安全.
nodes.diagnostic: evidence-level: code-confirmed taxonomy; 具体 training/play/export command 仍需要 runtime coverage.

children.title: GMT suffix observation stats
children.problem: 冻结 GMT stats 只能归一化 770D GMT-compatible suffix, 不能作用到完整 870D FrontRES actor observation.
children.method: 来源是 GMT checkpoint obs_norm_state_dict; 传播经过 policy.gmt_normalizer 和 OnPolicyRunner.obs_normalizer; 消费端是 apply_obs_normalizer suffix branch 和 GMT direct connector.
children.review: fake runner observation split 已 runtime-confirmed; train_mode freeze 已 code-confirmed; live long training 仍未确认.
children.forbidden: 不能把 combined 870D actor state 加载进 770D GMT normalizer, 也不能让 train_mode 更新 GMT stats.
children.diagnostic: frontres_observation_layout_contract.py prints gmt_normalizer_calls=[(2, 770)] and freeze contract expects eval()+until=0.

children.title: FrontRES prefix observation stats
children.problem: 100D FrontRES-only prefix 需要自己的 stats; legacy 800D checkpoints 只包含旧 30D anchor prefix.
children.method: extract_frontres_extra_norm_stats 读取 combined checkpoint stats, 把 legacy 30D 扩展到 100D, 新 70D balance prefix 使用 identity stats, 并保存 runner._frontres_extra_mean/std.
children.review: legacy 30D->100D expansion 和 100D restore 已 contract-confirmed; 从真实 checkpoint live resume 仍依赖具体 command.
children.forbidden: checkpoint stats 存在时不能让 100D prefix raw pass; 不能用 combined actor stats 静默覆盖 GMT stats.
children.diagnostic: frontres_segment_checkpoint_contract.py checks extra_mean_shape=(1, 100), first 30D legacy values preserved, new 70D identity stats.

children.title: Combined 870D actor observation payload
children.problem: checkpoint save 必须保存 actor-facing 870D normalizer state, 但 runtime GMT normalizer 仍然只能是 770D.
children.method: compose_frontres_obs_norm_state 只在 checkpoint payload 存储时组合 [100D extra prefix | 770D GMT suffix].
children.review: payload shape 已 contract-confirmed; 这不等价于 live run 已有高质量 empirical 100D prefix distribution.
children.forbidden: 不能把 combined 870D payload 当成 live GMT normalizer.
children.diagnostic: frontres_segment_checkpoint_contract.py checks saved obs_norm_state_dict mean/std/var shape=(1, 870).

children.title: Privileged observation normalizer
children.problem: Critic/privileged observation stats 可能独立于 actor obs stats 漂移, 也可能使用 fallback checkpoint keys.
children.method: 把 privileged_obs_norm_state_dict 的 save/load 与 obs_norm_state_dict 分开审计; 任何从 obs stats fallback 到 privileged stats 的分支都视为高风险兼容路径.
children.review: owner 已 code-confirmed; 还需要一个故意让 obs 与 privileged stats 不同的 checkpoint contract.
children.forbidden: 没有显式兼容警告和测试时, 不能把 actor obs_norm_state_dict 当 privileged stats 用.
children.diagnostic: frontres_segment_checkpoint_contract.py covers normalizer key presence; stronger differential stats fixture is still recommended.

children.title: Teacher / expert normalizers
children.problem: Teacher/expert observation paths 可能用不含 FrontRES 的名字更新或复用 student stats.
children.method: 单独跟踪 expert_normalize_obs, expert_update_normalizer, teacher_obs_normalizer, teacher_obs_norm_state_dict, MOSAIC-specific normalizer branches, 不和 Stage 3 actor stats 混在一起.
children.review: 风险面已 code-confirmed; 除非具体 run 启用 teacher/expert branches, 否则它不是当前 active Segment PPO stat fix 的一部分.
children.forbidden: 不能让 teacher/expert stats 静默更新 deployment actor stats.
children.diagnostic: 声称 unused 前, 需要针对具体 command 的 branch-specific config scan 或 coverage.

children.title: PPO advantage normalization
children.problem: mean/std 也会出现在 optimization statistics 中; 它们不是 observation stats, 但会改变 K-step reward scale 行为.
children.method: 把 advantage mean/std 与 checkpoint normalizers 分开归类; 审计 normalize_advantages 和 structured_joint_rl_normalize_advantage flags.
children.review: 这是独立 stat family, 已 code-confirmed; 不能与 obs mean/std 安全性结论混用.
children.forbidden: 不能用 obs-normalizer tests 证明 advantage normalization 行为.
children.diagnostic: 如果 K-step reward scale 或 normalize_advantages 成为可疑边界, 需要 tiny PPO fixture.

children.title: Export / play normalizer sinks
children.problem: deployment/export code 可能用 generic names 消费 normalizer, 并绕开 Stage 3 training contracts.
children.method: 审计 exporter.normalizer, my_on_policy_runner.export_policy_as_onnx, play/validation runner.load paths, normalizer dimension inference.
children.code: source/whole_body_tracking/whole_body_tracking/utils/exporter.py lines 55-137; source/whole_body_tracking/whole_body_tracking/utils/my_on_policy_runner.py export_policy_as_onnx; scripts robustness_validation load runner paths.
children.review: sink family 已 code-confirmed; Segment PPO contract suite 没覆盖它.
children.forbidden: 不能声称 training stat contract 已证明 ONNX/export/play 正确.
children.diagnostic: next test: fake normalizer with 770D/870D mismatch through exporter path, 或 exact play command coverage.

children.title: Coverage / trace gate
children.problem: 某条 code path 可以存在并通过局部测试, 但并不一定被具体 training/eval/play/export command 执行.
children.method: 对每个真实 command 跑 coverage.py JSON 或 Python trace, 标记 executed, expected-but-not-executed, executed-but-unexpected atlas blocks.
children.code: Atlas evidence level: exact command 用 coverage-confirmed 或 trace-confirmed; code-confirmed 只代表静态 ownership.
children.review: 这个 gate 把 stat map 从 owner inventory 转换为 whole-run execution evidence.
children.forbidden: 不能把 code-confirmed static map 当成 whole-run runtime coverage.
children.diagnostic: recommended: frontres/bin/python -m coverage run <contract-or-command>, 再 coverage json/html, 过滤 source/rsl_rl 和 source/whole_body_tracking.
